description: Source code for MIPS-specific stack walking in the Google Breakpad crash reporting system, including functions for retrieving context frames, caller frames, and stack scanning for return addresses.

classes.name: StackwalkerMIPS
classes.description: MIPS-specific implementation of stack walking, including context retrieval and stack scanning methods.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current context as a stack frame.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Determines the caller's stack frame either via CFI data or stack scanning.

methods.name: GetCallerByCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Uses CFI data to reconstruct the caller's register state and frame.

methods.name: GetCallerByStackScan
methods.description: Scans the stack memory to find the caller's return address and frame.
